pretreatments.description: Conditioning with polyacrylamide and dewatering using a belt filter press to a water content of approximately 80%.
Dilution of dewatered sludge using deionized water to reach a total solids (TS) content of 15%.
Low-temperature thermal pretreatment performed in sealed stainless steel tubes in a thermostatic water bath at temperatures between 50 °C and 80 °C for durations varying from 15 to 90 min.
